identityDecisions.name: Atomic dark matter
identityDecisions.yearMeaning: First arXiv posting of Kaplan et al.'s explicit two-fermion hidden-U(1) model; not the first possible atomic/composite/mirror dark matter idea
identityDecisions.notes: Dark proton and dark electron recombine to bound states under a new U(1) interaction. This is not an established DM identification. Check earlier atomic/mirror/composite literature before assigning umbrella origin.

identityDecisions.name: Dark acoustic oscillations
identityDecisions.yearMeaning: Evidence for DAO behavior in the 2012 and 2013 papers; historical origin and status as distinct framework versus model feature remains unresolved
identityDecisions.kind: dark-sector perturbation effect/signature, not a particle species
identityDecisions.notes: Sound waves arise from coupled interacting dark matter and dark radiation before decoupling. Do not misclassify as a new particle, a universal signal, or experimental confirmation.
